scenes.setting: Ritual circle around Sirius's corpse (visions only: Sirius writing the Clown formula, the Hanged Giant pendulum): Klein channels the spirit and is violently expelled
scenes.text_anchor: Klein twisted open the golden bottle's cap and brought it to his nose.

scenes.setting: The cordoned scene behind the library: Dunn, Leonard and Kenley arrive; Klein recounts the trail and hands over Sirius's letter — Aurora Order suspected
scenes.text_anchor: After a while, Klein saw Captain Dunn and his partners, Leonard and Kenley.

scenes.setting: Home on Daffodil Street: the exhausted Klein naps on the sofa, then gets up to cook Tomato Oxtail Soup before his siblings return
scenes.text_anchor: After leaving the Daffodil Street Library, Klein nearly fell asleep in the carriage
